answer: In this PoA model, EigenTrust reputation is multiplied by an exponential temporal-decay factor with a defined half-life, so influence requires sustained, honestly verified service instead of a short-lived burst. A freshly spawned sybil has near-zero eigenvector centrality because it lacks trusted incoming support; reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot make a hollow cluster self-supporting. Thus labels such as falcon or walnut confer no standing, and the identities cannot pass consensus.
